rules_objective_text: Welcome to Alliance, a strategic turnless elimination board game played on a coordinate grid. Your mission is simple: be the last surviving player on the board, OR unite with all surviving players to unanimously sign an Armistice peace treaty and share a collective victory!
rules_economy_text: There is no waiting for turns! You can act at any moment if you possess Action Points (AP). Every 24 hours at the scheduled server drop hour, the Game Master delivers fresh AP to every living player. You can hoard your AP for a multi-action blitz or spend it immediately to secure tactical position.
rules_actions_move: 🚶 MOVE (1 AP): Shift 1 tile orthogonally (North, South, East, West). Diagonals and walking into occupied spaces are prohibited.
rules_actions_attack: ⚔️ ATTACK (1 AP): Shoot any enemy inside your highlighted interaction range. Deals 1 Heart of damage! (Players have 3 Hearts by default—at 0 Hearts, you are eliminated and all your unspent AP is vaporized).
rules_actions_give: 🎁 GIVE AP (0-1 AP): Transfer AP from your balance to any ally inside your interaction range. Bribe neighbors, fund a proxy war, or rescue a friend!
rules_actions_upgrade: 📡 UPGRADE REACH: Permanently expands your interaction range outward, letting you strike and transfer across larger distances.
rules_burst_text: To prevent instant multi-kill rampages, action command payloads may consume no more than the configured Burst Cap (default: 3 AP). Receipts and state updates must be resolved before transmitting the next batch.
rules_range_title: 4. Interaction Range Geometry & Line of Sight
rules_fow_text: Opponents' exact Hearts and AP reserves are strictly confidential. When a player is struck by non-lethal fire, they receive a private alert that they took 1 damage, but the shooter's identity remains completely unknown. Only fatal strikes reveal the killer's call-sign.
